result: An actual N13 core p with at least one shared-core incidence from an A0 core cannot maximize any affine functional injective on a finite SharedCoreClosed set containing p.
assumptions: Every core has exactly three indexed supports
intermediateResults: Previous and next ordinary cap continuations force additional actual core endpoints in the same closed set.
Opposite-area collinear endpoints exclude an injective affine maximum.
An A0 back ray cannot have two adjacent triple-core tips.
Two antipodal actual shared-core tips exclude an injective affine maximum.
All normalized N13 ordinary-tip and A0-tip positions are discharged.
limitations: No global additive-per-component defect inequality is asserted.
The global all-core-triple assumption has not been removed.
This is structural upper-bound progress, not a numerical Kobon upper-bound record by itself.
